:::: {.hero}
# Moving Together

::: {.stand}
A three-day movement retreat for anyone. Yoga, tantra and improvised movement,
alone, in pairs and as a whole group. No experience needed.
:::
::::

::: {.band .band-moving}
:::

What happens when a room full of people stops moving the way they think they
should, and starts moving the way they actually feel? Some sessions start from
breath and awareness. Others open space for play and creative expression, where you follow,
lead, mirror and respond to the people around you, and find out what a group can
do that no one can do alone.

Over the days, there is room for old habits to soften, for attention to widen
from your own body to the people around you, and to be seen as you are, and to
meet others more authentically. No experience is needed, and there is no right
way to do any of it.

We will share the group agreements before you book. Throughout, you are free to
take part at your own pace — to sit out, or to watch.

:::: {.about}

::: {.ab}

[FG](../about/fg.qmd) and [DS](../about/ds.qmd), together.

::: {.ab}

:::

::: {.ab}
[When]{.k}

Tentatively September 2027. Three days.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Where]{.k}

Germany.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Touch]{.k}

Some exercises involve touch between participants, such as a hand on the back
or leaning into each other's weight. Touch is always optional: you can say no,
or change your mind, at any time without giving a reason, and there is always a
way to take part without it. Nothing in the retreat is sexual, and everyone
stays clothed.
:::

::: {.ab}

Accommodation and food.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Language]{.k}

English. Everyday English is enough.
:::
